title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Google Workspace MCP servers will reject OAuth clients not flagged as agentic, starting Nov 11, 2026 (flag locks Nov 12)
bullets.summary: Reported Oct 13 from a Google Workspace Team notice; via Brian Madden's AI-generated daily briefing, not independently confirmed.
bullets.how: The Construct: any agent using Gmail/Drive/Calendar MCP via an OAuth client must be re-registered as agentic before Nov 11 or those connectors may stop working; audit OAuth clients now. PRAGMA: client-readiness checklist item for Workspace automations. Brand 9 Signs: indirect, if B9 workflows use Google Workspace agents.

bullets.title: Anthropic managed-agents test: a swarm of 1,000 agents found 66 of 70 seeded bugs in a 116k-line codebase vs about 27 for a single agent
bullets.summary: Reported by AlphaSignal newsletter via Brian Madden's briefing (Oct 13); the original benchmark was not read.
bullets.how: The Construct: supports wide parallel swarms for audit/QA tasks, but cost and dedupe overhead are unknown; try on a small repo before adopting. PRAGMA: evidence for swarm-based review offers. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Microsoft's Nadella says frontier models should be treated as insider risks, with controls placed outside the model
bullets.summary: Reported via The Deep View (Oct 13 briefing); framing, not a product release.
bullets.how: The Construct: matches the existing rule to enforce permissions and approval gates outside the agent, so no change but a useful citation. PRAGMA: governance talking point for client AI-risk conversations. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Reliability math: a 75% per-attempt success rate falls to about 42% across three sequential steps
bullets.summary: Opinion AI post on eval-driven development, cited in the Oct 13 briefing.
bullets.how: The Construct: reminder to verify each step of multi-step agent chains rather than only the final output. PRAGMA: simple explainer for clients on why long agent pipelines need checkpoints. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

praxis_lesson: Connectors and permissions are controlled by the platform, not the agent: track vendor policy changes (like Google's agentic-client flag) and keep verification and approval gates outside the model.
